news.title: About 3.5 lakh new PMAY homes approved for Assam: Chief minister
news.para: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma engaged with Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, securing approval for the construction of 3.1 lakh homes under the PM Awas Yojana. This initiative marks an investment of Rs 5,000 crore aimed at enhancing housing in Assam, particularly benefiting areas affected by flooding. Furthermore, the state has been granted Rs 139 crore dedicated to agricultural development projects.

news.title: Cyberabad civic body orders crackdown on illegal buildings built on 75 sq yards, demolishes nine structures
news.para: Following a serious incident involving a building collapse, the Cyberabad Municipal Corporation is enhancing its crackdown on illegal constructions. A total of 38 structures have been flagged for enforcement actions. The focus is on those taller than permitted limits on compact plots, while also addressing projects on larger plots that lack the necessary permits. Continuous daily inspections are in place to ensure adherence to building regulations.

news.title: IHCL board approves merger of Oriental Hotels with share swap ratio of 25:117
news.para: The boards of Indian Hotels Company and Oriental Hotels have approved a scheme of arrangement for the amalgamation of Oriental Hotels with IHCL. The all-stock transaction proposes a share exchange ratio of 25 IHCL shares for every 117 Oriental Hotels shares.

news.title: CapitaLand India Trust shifts Singapore-dollar debt to rupees as INR falls
news.para: CapitaLand India Trust is converting more Singapore-dollar debt into rupee borrowings as the Indian currency weakens, aiming to reduce foreign exchange exposure and boost distributable cash flows. CLINT has completed two debt-onshoring tranches worth about S$204 million in 2026, lifting cumulative distribution-per-unit accretion from the exercises to nearly 5%.

news.title: Gurugram: DTCP cancels another project licence of Ocean Seven Buildtech
news.para: The town planning department of Gurgaon has revoked another project license belonging to Ocean Seven Buildtech due to ongoing construction delays and regulatory breaches. As a result, the purchasers of OSB Golf Heights are now left in a state of uncertainty regarding the project's future. Furthermore, the department has assumed control of the colony, hinting at potential additional actions.

news.title: Provisional booking no basis for allottee status: Haryana RERA junks plea
news.para: According to the Haryana RERA ruling, merely having a provisional allotment is insufficient to establish a promoter-allottee status. As a result, the complaint against Eldeco and HSIIDC was dismissed. The complainant did not sign or register the sale agreement, despite reminders. Eldeco confirmed its offer was withdrawn with a full refund, while HSIIDC reiterated that the plot allotment was conducted on an 'as is where is' basis.

news.title: Telangana RERA fines Chabbras Bentley Woods promoter for unregistered sales
news.para: Telangana RERA imposed a hefty fine of nearly one crore rupees on a developer for the unlawful sale of unregistered villas. The regulatory body has mandated a refund of twenty lakh rupees to an aggrieved buyer within a month. The developer, Chabbras Bentley Woods, misrepresented its project as a villa offering despite being registered only for plots.

news.title: Enforcement directorate advisory against fraudulent builders finds strong support in Odisha
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate's advisory against fraudulent practices in the Odisha real estate market has gained approval from various stakeholders. This crucial alert addresses concerns about project delays and regulatory compliance, with homebuyer associations viewing it as a reinforcement of consumer rights and accountability among builders. Legal experts express that the focus on cash transactions is essential for resolving halted projects.

news.title: Notandas Realty to invest ₹100 crore in Bandra West redevelopment project
news.para: Notandas Realty is set to transform Mon Bijou, a notable site in Bandra West, Mumbai. With an investment of around one hundred crore rupees, this project will rise on a 788 square metre plot and aim to deliver opulent residential spaces. Conveniently located off Carter Road, it promises luxury living. Notably, the company previously launched a similar high-end development in Juhu last year.

news.title: NBCC sells 111 flats in Noida via auction for ₹417 crore
news.para: NBCC India Ltd has successfully sold 111 residential units in Noida, garnering about Rs 416.53 crores through an e-auction at Aspire Silicon City in Uttar Pradesh. The firm will earn a one percent marketing fee based on the total sales value. Additionally, NBCC is committed to completing stalled Amrapali projects mandated by the Supreme Court and is developing over 10,000 apartments across five ongoing Amrapali initiatives.

news.title: Prozone Realty completes ₹1,242.50 crore mall asset sale to Inorbit Malls
news.para: Prozone Realty has completed the sale of identified subsidiaries holding operational mall assets to Inorbit Malls (India) for an aggregate gross consideration of ₹1,242.50 crore. Kruti Realtors, Alliance Mall Developers and Empire Mall have ceased to be subsidiaries of the company.

news.title: ED summons Punjab IAS officer Anurag Verma in PMLA case linked to realty projects
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has called IAS officer Anurag Verma in for questioning regarding a money laundering investigation that involves alleged discrepancies in land use. They aim to clarify project layout changes attributed to his oversight. Additionally, another IAS officer, Kanwal Preet Brar, has been issued a new summons. This case originated from a police FIR concerning fraudulent consent claims made by farmers.

news.title: UP-RERA grants four-month extension to eligible projects hit by West Asia crisis
news.para: UP-RERA has extended the registration validity and completion period of eligible registered real estate projects by four months, following the MoHUA advisory dated July 31, 2026. Projects whose original, revised or extended completion dates fall between February 28, 2026 and October 31, 2026, will be eligible, subject to regulatory compliances.

news.title: The House of Abhinandan Lodha & NITCO to jointly develop mixed-use project in Alibaug
news.para: The House of Abhinandan Lodha, through its subsidiary HoABL Impactum Land, has signed an MoU with NITCO, NITCO Realties and promoter Vivek Talwar to develop land parcels in Alibaug. The project is expected to generate ₹3,000 crore revenue for HoABL and ₹1,500 crore for NITCO over five years.

news.title: Schindler India launches new experience centre in Gurugram; reinforcing our commitment to sustainable urban mobility
news.para: Schindler India has unveiled its new Experience Centre in Gurugram, highlighting advancements in vertical mobility solutions. During the launch, a panel of experts deliberated on creating sustainable, interconnected urban spaces in the Delhi-NCR region by 2030. They stressed the importance of transit-oriented development, walkable neighborhoods, and eco-friendly construction practices, while also calling for supportive policies. Schindler reaffirmed its commitment to Net Zero and introduced an environmentally conscious maintenance contract.

news.title: Property tax powers Chandigarh civic body's ₹134 crore own revenue haul
news.para: During the months of April to June, property tax became a cornerstone of the Chandigarh municipal corporation's finances, yielding over Rs 134 crore in revenue. This surge was partly due to timely rebates provided to taxpayers. The civic authority, however, faced expenses of Rs 254 crore, primarily from salaries. A notable amount was dedicated to crucial development initiatives, particularly in road construction and upgrades.

news.title: Gurugram: 450 families in Imperia Esfera rely on diesel generator set as snag sparks outages
news.para: The inhabitants of Imperia Esfera in Gurgaon are facing an ongoing nightmare of power outages that have persisted for three days, impacting about 450 residences. Continuous electrical issues have rendered their temporary 11-kV power connection inefficient. In a bid for clarity and permanence, residents are calling for a collaborative investigation to pinpoint responsibility.

news.title: Puravankara to jointly develop 7.83-acre land parcel in Bengaluru
news.para: Puravankara has entered into a joint development agreement for a 7.83-acre land parcel in southeast Bengaluru. The project has an estimated gross development value of ₹1,100 crore and a saleable area of about 0.89 million sq ft.

news.title: Change in revenue record doesn't create, end property title: SC
news.para: The Supreme Court has established that mutations in revenue records do not establish ownership of property. The ruling quashed an order from the Madhya Pradesh High Court, highlighting that disputes over titles require evidence beyond mere revenue entries, which serve only fiscal purposes and do not imply rights. Civil courts retain the authority to ascertain the actual title while revenue entries are maintained separately.

news.title: Over 800 unauthorised buildings identified across Cyberabad civic body limits
news.para: The Cyberabad Municipal Corporation has uncovered more than 800 unauthorized constructions across its three zones, with Kukatpally zone showing the highest number at 365 violations. Enforcement measures, including show-cause notices, demolitions, and seizures, have been initiated. Many building owners exploit loopholes to bypass regulations. The civic body strongly encourages residents to report any violations via the My CURE app.
